*[http://www.emtec-international.com/de-eu/old_drivers Drivers on '''Emtec''''s site]
'''Emtec''''s drivers note the chip used as RTL8709. <small> :This would seem to be another name for RTL8192U (RTL81xxSU is aka RTL8712) - :the USB ID is noted in the Linux driver for '''r8192u_usb''' which handles those devices. </small> :It is presumed to be using RTL8192U + RTL8256...
Based on the dongle's appearance, ''[[Edimax]]'' is the presumed manufacturer.
*[http://forum.ubuntu-it.org/viewtopic.php?t=363139 Appears to have a 0bda:8709 USB ID]
